cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Record My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I put a star beside my name like yours. Credit marked. Put me under cake design before you frame our prize certificate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My star means the spelling needs checking. Everyone knows you designed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Spelling noted. Next year's members won't. There's a blank ready for them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We usually credit the whole baking team.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: List us all, with what each did. I'll fetch everyone's names before you seal the frame.
